paper_title: A Search for Invisible Axion Dark Matter with the Axion Dark Matter Experiment
coupling_convention: |g_agammagamma| in GeV^-1, read from axis labeled in units of 10^-16 GeV^-1 (multiplier applied); N-body lineshape (blue) limit traced as the lower exclusion boundary
notes: ADMX Gen-2 haloscope search (Run 1A), masses 2.66-2.81 ueV (645-680 MHz). First haloscope to exclude DFSZ axion-photon coupling (100% DM). No numerical table given; data points are approximate DFSZ-level couplings (~4e-16 GeV^-1 at these masses) reconstructed from the paper's statement that DFSZ axions are excluded between 645 and 676 MHz and from Fig. 4 (y-axis in 1e-16 GeV^-1). Two lineshape analyses: Maxwellian (SHM, rho=0.45 GeV/cm^3) and N-body (rho=0.63 GeV/cm^3); dm_density_assumed set to 0.45 for the standard halo model result. Region 660.16-660.27 MHz vetoed due to RF interference. 90% CL upper limits; systematic uncertainty ~13%. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.85, 48)) | Vision: ADMX 2018 result (PRL 120, 151301), Fig. 4: 90% CL excluded region for 2.66-2.81 ueV (645-680 MHz). Two limit curves shown: red (Maxwellian, isothermal halo, rho=0.45 GeV/cm^3) and blue (N-body lineshape, rho=0.63 GeV/cm^3). The blue N-body curve, being the lower boundary of the excluded region, was traced. Y-axis linear in units of 10^-16 GeV^-1 (0-18); x-axis linear in ueV (2.63-2.9). DFSZ line sits at ~3.5e-16 across the band; KSVZ at ~1.0e-15. Curve is noisy; points are smoothed local averages. Grey vetoed region near 660.2 MHz (~2.731 ueV) interpolated across.
